key_insight: A²ODA combines adaptive acceleration with low-cost p-norm preconditioning for unconstrained convex optimization, using a unified update structure for p ∈ [2, ∞].
engineering_relevance: The method offers a line-search-free approach to large-scale first-order optimization without more elaborate updates for p > 2 than for the Euclidean case.
method: Use adaptive accelerated optimistic dual averaging with p-norm preconditioning.
Select step sizes through an aggregated affine lower model, without line search.
Analyze constant and gap-dependent curvature separately under generalized local smoothness.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical convergence bounds, including a nearly optimal rate under local smoothness, but provides no empirical benchmarks.
watch_item: Practical speedups and preconditioning overhead remain unverified by the abstract; convergence guarantees depend on the stated smoothness conditions.
paper_title: A simple adaptive accelerated optimistic dual averaging method for unconstrained convex optimization in $p$-norm geometry
